privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Oman Property Intelligence is a real-estate information service. This page explains, in plain words, what personal information the site collects, why, and what happens to it.
privacy.collectAccount: Account details — your name, email address, and password. The password is stored only in a scrambled (hashed) form; we cannot read it.
privacy.collectEnquiry: Buyer enquiries — when you send an enquiry about a property, we store the name, email address, phone number (optional), and message you type. These details are shown to the site administrator and to the estate agency whose listing you asked about, so they can reply to you.
privacy.collectAgency: Agency details — an agency that signs up provides its company name, licence number, contact email and phone number, and may upload a logo.
privacy.collectPhotos: Property photos — photos uploaded for a listing are stored on our server and shown publicly with that listing.
privacy.collectAi: AI analyst questions — when you ask the AI property analyst a question, the question and the answer are saved with your account, so there is an auditable record of what the analyst said. The question text is also processed by our AI service provider in order to generate the answer.
privacy.collectFavorites: Favourites — which listings you have saved, linked to your account.
privacy.collectTechnical: Technical basics — a login cookie that keeps you signed in, and short-lived counters that protect the site against abuse. We do not use advertising or tracking cookies. If technical error monitoring is switched on, reports about server faults may be processed solely to keep the site working.
privacy.useBody: We use this information only to run the service: to operate your account, to pass your enquiry to the right agency, to show listings and market data, to answer your questions to the AI analyst, and to keep the site safe. We do not sell personal information.
privacy.shareBody: Enquiry details are visible to the site administrator and to the agency the enquiry is for. Listing content and property photos are public. Everything else stays private to your account and the site administrator.
privacy.retentionBody: Account information is kept for as long as your account exists. Enquiries are kept so the agency and the administrator can follow up on them. AI questions and answers are kept as a record of the analyst's output. If you would like your account, an enquiry, or other personal information deleted, contact us and we will remove it unless the law requires us to keep it.
privacy.pdplTitle: Your rights under Oman's data protection law
privacy.pdplBody: Oman's Personal Data Protection Law (Royal Decree 6/2022) gives you rights over your personal data — including asking to see it, correct it, or delete it. To exercise any of these rights, contact us using the details below.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.intro: These terms apply when you use Oman Property Intelligence. By using the site you accept them.
terms.infoBody: Market figures on this site are indicative, and every figure is labeled with its source and confidence. Nothing on the site is financial, legal, or investment advice. Always verify property regulations, ownership eligibility, prices, and financing with the official authorities and your bank before making decisions.
terms.aiBody: Answers from the AI property analyst are generated automatically from the data stored on this platform. They carry confidence labels, can be incomplete or wrong, and are not advice.
terms.accountsBody: Keep your login details private and give us accurate information. We may suspend accounts that abuse the service, send spam enquiries, or try to disrupt the site.
terms.listingsBody: Agencies are responsible for the accuracy of the listings they submit. Submitted listings are reviewed before publication, but we do not guarantee any listing's accuracy, availability, or price — confirm details directly with the agency.
terms.liabilityBody: The service is provided as-is. To the extent permitted by law, we accept no liability for decisions made based on the information shown here. Nothing in these terms excludes liability that cannot be excluded under Omani law.
terms.lawBody: These terms are governed by the laws of the Sultanate of Oman.
terms.changesBody: We may update these terms from time to time; the “last updated” date above shows the current version. Continuing to use the site means you accept the updated version.
